## Change

Describe the user-visible documentation or site change and affected B&W/Railroader versions.

## Version and maintenance review

- [ ] Classified as development docs, new release snapshot, explicit archive erratum, or site maintenance.
- [ ] Related behavior and downloadable examples audited against their intended version.
- [ ] Unreleased status, game compatibility, and validation limitations are accurate.
- [ ] Existing public URLs retained; no implementation files or private context included.
- [ ] `npm run check:audit` and `npm run build` pass.
- [ ] For a release: version snapshot, manifest, archive digest, and deployed URL checked.
- [ ] For an erratum: correction reason and archive revision recorded.

## Verification

Record the checks performed and any remaining acceptance work. Link only public sources here; keep cross-references to private code PRs in the private repository.
